extensionDescription.message: Codex chats in new tabs, alongside your pages, with scoped browser tools.

helperHint.message: Tabgent needs a local connector to communicate with Codex on your Mac. Install it once, then return to your chat.

helperStepOne.message: Download and unzip the connector package, then run Install Connector.command.

helperStepTwo.message: Return to your chat and choose Check again. Tabgent will then check your Codex installation and guide you through sign-in if needed.

helperPrivacy.message: Messages, requested page content, screenshots and relevant attachments are sent through Codex to your configured service. They are not processed only on your computer. Tabgent has no separate cloud service processing your chats.

helperLaunchFailed.message: The local connector could not start or was disconnected. Try reconnecting. If this continues, run Install Connector.command again. This does not mean Codex is missing.
